name: Sherlock Holmes
summary: Consulting detective of 221B Baker Street.

name: John H. Watson
summary: Army surgeon invalided home from Afghanistan; Holmes's friend, fellow lodger and chronicler.

name: Mary Morstan
summary: Governess who brings Holmes the case of the pearls in The Sign of the Four; Watson's fiancée by its end.

name: Mycroft Holmes
summary: Sherlock's elder brother, a founder of the Diogenes Club.

name: Mrs. Hudson
summary: Keeps the house at 221B Baker Street.

name: Inspector Lestrade
summary: Scotland Yard detective.

name: Tobias Gregson
summary: Scotland Yard detective, Lestrade's rival.

name: Athelney Jones
summary: Scotland Yard detective in The Sign of the Four.

name: Jefferson Hope
summary: American cabman who avenges Lucy Ferrier in A Study in Scarlet.

name: John Ferrier
summary: Settler in Utah who adopts Lucy.

name: Lucy Ferrier
summary: John Ferrier's adopted daughter, loved by Jefferson Hope.

name: Enoch J. Drebber
summary: The man found dead at Lauriston Gardens.

name: Joseph Stangerson
summary: Drebber's secretary.

name: John Rance
summary: The constable who found the body at Lauriston Gardens.

name: Jonathan Small
summary: One-legged convict who tells the story of the Agra treasure.

name: Thaddeus Sholto
summary: Major Sholto's son; writes to Mary Morstan.

name: Bartholomew Sholto
summary: Thaddeus's twin brother, found dead at Pondicherry Lodge.

name: Major John Sholto
summary: Officer who took the Agra treasure; father of Thaddeus and Bartholomew.

name: Captain Arthur Morstan
summary: Mary Morstan's father, who disappeared in London in 1878.

name: Mrs. Cecil Forrester
summary: Mary Morstan's employer.

name: Mordecai Smith
summary: Owner of the steam launch Aurora.

name: Irene Adler
summary: Opera singer who outwits Holmes in A Scandal in Bohemia.

name: Neville St. Clair
summary: The missing man in The Man with the Twisted Lip.

name: Lord St. Simon
summary: The bridegroom in The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor.

name: Paul Kratides
summary: The Greek prisoner in The Greek Interpreter.

name: Sophy Kratides
summary: Paul's sister.
